propositions: A CI measurement harness must run n=10 structured-output test cases (agentic-transcript and single-shot prompts) across provider-model cells (anthropic, bedrock, openai) with current and sentinel directive variants to capture raw replies and score parse success and layout distribution
The sentinel directive changes model output layout from fenced/multi-object code to 100% prose format, raising parse success rates on anthropic and bedrock from ~40% to ~55%
The harness must respect per-provider API credential scoping (.github/llm-providers/*.toml) and record cells without credentials as 'unmeasured' without failing the job
A workflow-input call-budget cap (default 300 calls/run) must be enforced before any network call, with unit tests confirming the cap is evaluated at orchestration time
Deterministic scoring (parse success count and layout-class distribution) must be unit-testable offline against committed E2 fixture replies before live workflow_dispatch runs are operator-attested
The live baseline measurement workflow must upload raw-reply artifacts and a scored before/after table per provider arm as evidence
